ABOUT OUR DIY ESCAPE ROOM GAMES

Welcome to MysteryLocks Home Escape Rooms, your go-to destination for thrilling and easy-to-set-up Printable Escape Rooms! Whether you're planning a special occasion or simply seeking a fun adventure, our Printable Escape Rooms are the perfect choice. With our convenient Print & Play system, all it takes is downloading the files, printing the documents, and preparing for an unforgettable experience!

Discover the excitement of our over 60 unique themes, catering to a wide range of interests and ages. From Printable Party Games for Kids to engaging Family Games, we have something for everyone. With our flexible approach, you can even customize the game to your liking by incorporating various Escape Room Props or Escape Room Decor.

Looking for an extra challenge? Take on our Escape Room Puzzles or try your hand at a DIY Escape Game using our comprehensive Escape Room Kit. It's a fantastic team-building activity that guarantees hours of fun and excitement. If you're planning a celebration, our Escape Room Party option is the perfect way to create unforgettable memories with friends and family.

For a dynamic and interactive experience, embark on an Interactive Scavenger Hunt that will keep you engaged and entertained throughout. Solve brain-teasing puzzles and immerse yourself in the immersive world of our Escape Room Adventure.

Are you up for the challenge? Dive into the mysteries with our Printable Mystery Games, designed to test your problem-solving skills. Unravel clues and crack codes with our Printable Clue Games, leading you closer to solving the ultimate mystery.

At MysteryLocks Home Escape Rooms, we take pride in delivering impeccable customer service. If you have any questions or need assistance, our dedicated team is here to support you every step of the way. Get ready to unlock the excitement and adventure that awaits you at MysteryLocks Home Escape Rooms!

⏳ Gameplay: 30 - 45 Minutes
🙋‍♂️ Age: 7 and up
👥 Number of players: 1-4

The cracking sound of wood burning in the fireplace and the delicious smell of hot chocolate fills the room. Christmas music plays in the background and the kids are playing by the Christmas tree. When everyone gathered for the Christmas Dinner, the lights dimmed and the candles lit up. A large box appeared under the Christmas tree. Filled with snow globes, gingerbread, gifts and candy canes, it was a true mystery how it appeared. And somehow, everything was connected- pictures, letters and puzzles were everywhere inside. It's your time to uncover the mysteries and be part of The Great Christmas Escape.

⏳ GAMEPLAY

Our adventures are designed to offer 15-45 minutes of fun, based on players’ experience, skill, age and group size. For a longer experience, you can turn our games into treasure hunts by hiding the game materials around the play space and letting the players find them before starting the game or chapters.

🙋‍♂️ AGE

Our recommended age is only a suggestion. Younger players may also join the fun, but with a bit of guidance from a supervisor.

👥 NUMBER OF PLAYERS

We designed the games for up to four players, but you can adapt them no matter the size of your group. Create smaller teams and print a set of game materials for each team. Add a bit of competition and let the best team escape before everyone else!

✂️ SET-UP & ADDITIONAL MATERIALS

To set-up the game, you need nothing more than paper, the provided PDF documents, a colour printer or printing service, and a pair of scissors. For most of our games, a phone connected to the Internet is also required to check the final answer. You don’t need any locks, envelopes or special equipment. The person that sets-up the game can also join the fun!

🎊 OCCASIONS

Our adventures are perfect for parties, date nights, family dinners, classroom activities and team building activities!

📄 INCLUDED DOCUMENTS

1. A PDF file with the instructions and game materials
2. A PDF file with the walkthrough of the game and solutions
3. A PDF game certificate

🖥 HOW TO DOWNLOAD

If you have an Etsy account, after your purchase you’ll see a View your files link which goes to the Downloads page. Here, you can download all the files associated with your order.

If you don’t have an Etsy account, you'll find a link to download your purchase in the receipt email that was sent to you after purchase.

🎄 CHRISTMAS CHARADES GAME 🎄

Add some FUN + LAUGHTER to your Christmas celebration with this printable Christmas Charades Game!

With 96 festive charades cards, this game is packed with Christmas movies, songs, actions + objects for players to act out while their teammates race to guess the answer.     

Once the actor announces the category, no more talking — acting only! 

Perfect for kids, teens + adults, this easy-to-play Christmas game is a fun addition to family gatherings, classroom parties, church groups, Girl Scout or Cub Scout parties, office celebrations and more.

🎁 WHAT’S INCLUDED
✔️ 96 Christmas Charades Cards

✔️ Full Game Instructions
✔️ 16 pages of game cards
✔️ 1 instruction page
✔️ US Letter Size PDF
✔️ Instant Digital Download  

The game includes movie, song, action and object prompts, with 6 cards printed per sheet.     


🎉 HOW TO PLAY
- Split your group into 2 teams.
- One player draws a card and announces whether it is a Movie, Song, Action or Object. After that — no talking!
- Act out the clue while your teammates try to guess correctly. Keep each card your team guesses, and the first team to collect 15 cards wins!     

👥 PERFECT FOR
🎄 Family Christmas Parties
🎄 Classroom Holiday Parties
🎄 Church Christmas Parties
🎄 Office + Work Parties
